description: Lists the Argentine streaming, radio and TV channels that are live right now, ordered by concurrent viewers measured by Prim, with the programme on air, the platforms (YouTube, Twitch, Kick) with their watch links and the canonical url of each channel's page on prim.profblu.com. Optionally filter by channel name. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

channel.description: Only this channel (name or slug, e.g. «Luzu TV» or luzu-tv).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

limit.description: How many channels, 1 to 50. Defaults to 15.

name: who_is_live_now

title.description: Title of the live stream on its platform

url.description: Canonical page of the channel on prim.profblu.com: cite it

liveChannels.description: How many channels are live right now in total

notLive.description: Only when channel names a channel that exists but is not live right now

nextShow.description: The channel's next programme in Prim's schedule (today or tomorrow, Buenos Aires)

url.description: Canonical page of the channel on prim.profblu.com: cite it

suggestions.description: Only when what was asked for is not in Prim (or matches several): up to 3 similar names, to ask the user «did you mean…?». Nothing is claimed about them.

totalViewers.description: Concurrent viewers across all of them

title: Who is live now on Argentine streaming
